threats.title: Forged PLC write via flat MQTT topics
preconditions: rogue agent holds any valid credential with MQTT publish scope
flat topic ACLs let a non-operator publisher reach command topics
threats.stopping_policy: Only the operator agent may write PLC registers, and only via the gateway; unknown or revoked identities denied by default.

threats.title: Fake gate release without matching booking
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/yard/gate/release
no container + truck + booking match enforced
threats.stopping_policy: Gate release requires matching container + truck + booking; mismatches denied and the requester quarantined.

threats.title: Direct-to-PLC write bypassing the gateway
preconditions: rogue agent has network reachability to localhost:5020
PLC accepts unauthenticated Modbus writes
threats.stopping_policy: Any traffic to the PLC that bypasses the gateway is denied and flagged as an anomaly.

threats.title: Forged yard container move dispatching hostler equipment
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/yard/container/move under flat topic ACLs
yard-container-moves accepts move commands without operator publisher identity check
no matching booked container move is enforced before dispatch to yard-equipment-hostler-1
threats.stopping_policy: Only the operator agent may publish container moves, and only for a matching booked container move; unknown publishers denied by default and quarantined.

threats.title: PLC write through gateway without operator authorization
preconditions: rogue agent has network reachability to the edge gateway PLC forwarding path
PLC accepts unauthenticated Modbus writes forwarded via the gateway
gateway does not enforce that only operator-agent originates PLC writes
threats.stopping_policy: Only the operator agent may write PLC registers, and only via the gateway; unknown or revoked identities denied by default.

threats.title: Spoofed pressure telemetry tricking operator into unsafe PLC action
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/line1/sensors/pressure under flat topic ACLs
only sensor-pressure-line1 should publish this topic but publisher identity is not enforced
operator agent acts on pressure telemetry without publisher identity or plausibility checks
threats.stopping_policy: Only sensor-pressure-line1 may publish to site/line1/sensors/pressure; telemetry from unknown publishers is denied and flagged, and operator agent must not convert unverified telemetry into PLC writes.

threats.title: Spoofed temperature telemetry tricking operator into unsafe PLC action
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/line1/sensors/temperature under flat topic ACLs
only sensor-temp-line1 should publish this topic but publisher identity is not enforced
operator agent acts on temperature telemetry without publisher identity or plausibility checks
threats.stopping_policy: Only sensor-temp-line1 may publish to site/line1/sensors/temperature; telemetry from unknown publishers is denied and flagged, and operator agent must not convert unverified telemetry into PLC writes.

threats.title: Wildcard topic reconnaissance
preconditions: broker accepts '#' subscriptions from non-gateway identities
threats.stopping_policy: No agent may subscribe to the wildcard topic '#'; violators quarantined and wildcard disabled for non-gateway identities.

threats.title: Spoofed reefer temperature tricking the operator
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to reefer telemetry topics
operator agent acts on telemetry without plausibility checks
threats.stopping_policy: Reefer temperature changes greater than 10C in one minute are implausible: flagged, not acted on; publisher scope revoked.

threats.title: Spoofed gate events masking container moves
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/yard/gate/event
gate events accepted without publisher identity check
threats.stopping_policy: Gate publishers must hold yard-publish scope; unknown publishers denied by default.

threats.title: Spoofed hostler equipment status misleading the operator
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/yard/equipment/<id>/status under flat topic ACLs
only yard-equipment-hostler-1 should publish its own equipment status but publisher identity is not enforced
operator agent acts on equipment status without publisher identity checks
threats.stopping_policy: Only yard-equipment-hostler-1 may publish to site/yard/equipment/<id>/status for its own id; unknown publishers denied by default and flagged.

threats.title: Spoofed vibration telemetry masking a fault or forcing a PLC stop
preconditions: rogue agent can publish to site/line1/sensors/vibration under flat topic ACLs
only sensor-vibration-line1 should publish this topic but publisher identity is not enforced
operator agent acts on vibration telemetry without publisher identity or plausibility checks
threats.stopping_policy: Only sensor-vibration-line1 may publish to site/line1/sensors/vibration; telemetry from unknown publishers is denied and flagged, and operator agent must not convert unverified telemetry into PLC writes.
